title: Project Sync
summary: The team reviewed the website redesign, noting that wireframes are complete and awaiting the final colour palette. Budget concerns were raised due to a 10% overage in cloud costs, leading to a decision to downgrade the staging server. Action items were assigned for Meera to provide the palette by Friday and for John to implement the server change by next Wednesday. The timing of the product launch relative to the festival sale remains unresolved and will be addressed in the next meeting.
discussion_points: Wireframes for the website redesign are finished
Final colour palette is needed from Meera
Suggestion to move the staging server to a smaller plan
Open question about launching before or after the festival sale
decisions: Move the staging server to the smaller plan

action_items.task: Change the staging server to the smaller plan

open_questions: Should the product launch occur before or after the festival sale?
